vm.testHarness: Interactive Task Scheduler launches Node, which starts Argus through Explorer Shell.Application; lifecycle verification waits for the real normal process exit.
invalidatedAttempts: Direct guest-control/task child launches could be terminated before Windows window notifications. These were replaced by independent Explorer launches.
One Windows/VirtualBox restart stalled after guest services exited. The VM was reset for recovery; that attempt was not counted as a completed restart. A subsequent complete restart passed.

The first post-logoff launcher could not read HKCU while the user hive was unloaded. Marker removal and absence of Argus/Explorer were checked directly; the next-start check was completed after automatic login on a regular reboot.

knownPreexistingTests.reason: Legacy tests reject the isolated shortcut worker spawn introduced by 0.58.29 and match the obsolete boot.js comment marker.

limitations: Colleague root cause remains unconfirmed without time-matched logs/configuration.
Legacy numeric running markers have no end timestamp; interruption is reported with unknown cause and no historical log attribution.
Forced power loss cannot be distinguished from forced process termination without confirmed session-end.
